milestones.title: Started B.Tech Journey
milestones.description: Joined KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur for a B.E. in Computer Science specializing in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning.

milestones.title: Wanderlust (First Project)
milestones.description: Built Wanderlust, my first full-stack travel listing platform following MVC architecture with robust authentication and Joi schema validation.

milestones.title: Connectify (Second Project)
milestones.description: Developed Connectify, a real-time video conferencing platform using WebRTC and Socket.io for live communication and meeting management.

milestones.title: MarketPulse & Hackathons
milestones.description: Built MarketPulse, a full-stack trading ecosystem. Participated in the 7th Edition HSIL Hackathon in collaboration with Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.

milestones.title: GetIt (AI Search)
milestones.description: Developed GetIt, a local multimodal semantic search engine utilizing Python, OpenAI CLIP, and Salesforce BLIP for hybrid AI-powered image discovery.
